mapped_layers.graph: citation, author, test-lineage, contradiction and trait-transmission relations
mapped_layers.evidence: R2 independence scoring and effect cards
mapped_layers.experiments: controlled tests reusable as Genesis evaluation gates where appropriate

integration_rules: IO observations inform Genesis but do not override Genesis local state-transition authority.
Genesis gameplay is a candidate observation environment, not automatically a scientific experiment.
Any Genesis-derived claim promoted into IO must carry model, version, prompt/context, test, scoring and provenance metadata.
Correlated agents must be collapsed before treating multi-agent agreement as independent support.
A belief revision caused only by social agreement is logged as conformity pressure, not evidence gain.
A belief revision caused by new independently checkable information is legitimate updating.
Anthropomorphic interpretations remain separate hypotheses requiring their own evidence.
